sentences.text: 2. The petitioners are asking for compensation in terms of Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
It is informed by the learned A.G.P. that the State has preferred an appeal against the award passed by the Land Acquisition Officer and the said appeal is pending.

3. In view of the Apex Court's judgment in the case of Bharatsing Gulabsingh Jakhad and others vs. State of Maharshtra and others, reported in 2018 (11) SCC 92, the petitioners' claim could not be entertained unless and until the appeal preferred by the State is decided and the order granting cp613.21 compensation attains the finality.
